configureSplitter(address).notice: One-time Safe configuration avoids circular constructor dependencies.

setFee((address,address,address,address,.notice: Safe may set arbitrary allowed Morpho fees; splitter may only set the         fee computed during its own atomic createMarket flow.

setOwner(address).notice: Safe may transfer the underlying Morpho ownership out of this         contract at any time, including back to the Safe itself.

createMarket((address,address,address,ad.notice: One permissionless transaction: register creator, create market,         configure its actual Morpho fee, then activate creator accounting.         Any failed downstream operation reverts the ENTIRE market creation.

setCreatorReceiver(bytes32,address).notice: The original creator or the CURRENT designated creator-fee         receiver may redirect the creator portion. The treasury is separate.
